abstract: Five cases of non-molar trophoblastic disease including one placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), two exaggerated placental sites and two choriocarcinomas were compared with each other and with normal chorionic villi and placental site. This involved light microscopic, immunohistochemical and ultrastructural studies. Comparison of PSTT with choriocarcinoma suggested that the former represented a neoplastic transformation of placental site intermediate trophoblast. The PSTT showed a characteristic immunohistochemical distribution of human placental lactogen and human chorionic gonadotropin, resembling that of the placental site intermediate trophoblast. Placental site trophoblastic tumor cells were also characterized ultrastructurally by prominent perinuclear filaments, abundant rough endoplasmic reticulum, or both. Infiltrating intermediate trophoblasts in exaggerated placental sites were similar to PSTT cells rather than normal placental site intermediate trophoblasts. However cells with vacuolated cytoplasm or spindle-shaped intermediate trophoblastic cells were observed more frequently in the PSTT than the exaggerated placental sites. The intermediate trophoblastic cells in the choriocarcinomas showed a morphologically transitional form from cytotrophoblastic cell to syncytiotrophoblastic cell, but did not share unique ultrastructural similarities with placental site intermediate trophoblasts.
abstract_ja: 5例の非奇胎性絨毛性疾患(胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)1例、過剰な胎盤部2例、絨毛癌2例)を、正常絨毛および胎盤部と比較した。光顕、免疫組織化学、超微細構造の検討を行った。PSTTと絨毛癌の比較から、前者は胎盤部中間型栄養膜細胞の腫瘍性変化を表すことが示唆された。PSTTは胎盤性ラクトゲン(hPL)およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の免疫組織化学的分布が、胎盤部中間型栄養膜細胞のそれに類似していた。PSTT細胞は超微細構造上も、核周囲のフィラメントの顕著な増加、豊富な粗面小胞体、またはその両方を特徴とした。過剰な胎盤部の浸潤性中間型栄養膜細胞はPSTT細胞に似ており、正常な胎盤部中間型栄養膜細胞とは異なっていた。しかし、PSTTでは空胞化した細胞質を有する細胞や紡錘形の中間型栄養膜細胞が、過剰な胎盤部よりも頻繁に観察された。絨毛癌の中間型栄養膜細胞は、細胞栄養膜細胞から合胞体栄養膜細胞へと移行する形態を示したが、胎盤部中間型栄養膜細胞と特有の超微細構造上の類似点は共有していなかった。
